SELECT oh.purchase_order_id AS purchaseOrderId, od.purchase_order_detail_id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, oh.order_no AS orderNo, oh.order_dt AS orderDt, c.customer_name AS supplierName, u.user_nm AS ordererName, CASE WHEN oh.use_at = 'Y' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'CANCELED' END AS status, oh.source_type AS sourceType, oh.tax_type AS taxType, tci.item_nm AS taxTypeName, oh.vat_included_at AS vatIncludedAt, oh.supply_amt AS headerSupplyAmt, oh.vat_amt AS headerVatAmt, oh.total_amt AS headerTotalAmt, oh.remark AS headerRemark, od.line_no AS lineNo, pc.confirm_no AS confirmNo, rh.request_no AS requestNo, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.material_spec AS materialSpec, m.unit AS unit, od.order_qty AS orderQty, od.unit_price AS unitPrice, od.delivery_dt AS deliveryDt, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, od.inspect_at AS inspectAt, od.receipt_close_at AS receiptCloseAt, oh.print_at AS printAt, od.supply_amt AS supplyAmt, od.vat_amt AS vatAmt, od.total_amt AS totalAmt, oci.item_nm AS orderTypeName, uci.item_nm AS useTypeName, od.remark AS remark FROM tb_purchase_order_hd oh JOIN tb_purchase_order_dt od ON od.purchase_order_id = oh.purchase_order_id AND od.tenant_id = oh.tenant_id JOIN tb_purchase_request_dt rd ON rd.purchase_request_detail_id = od.purchase_request_detail_id JOIN tb_purchase_request_hd rh ON rh.purchase_request_id = rd.purchase_request_id AND rh.tenant_id = rd.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_purchase_confirm_hd pc ON pc.purchase_confirm_id = rd.purchase_confirm_id AND pc.tenant_id = rd.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = oh.supplier_id AND c.tenant_id = oh.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = oh.orderer_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = od.material_id AND m.tenant_id = od.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = od.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group tcg ON tcg.tenant_id = oh.tenant_id AND tcg.group_code = 'PURCHASE_TAX_TYPE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item tci ON tci.group_id = tcg.common_code_group_id AND tci.item_code = oh.tax_type LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group ocg ON ocg.tenant_id = od.tenant_id AND ocg.group_code = 'PURCHASE_ORDER_TYPE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item oci ON oci.group_id = ocg.common_code_group_id AND oci.item_code = od.order_type LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group ucg ON ucg.tenant_id = od.tenant_id AND ucg.group_code = 'PURCHASE_USE_TYPE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item uci ON uci.group_id = ucg.common_code_group_id AND uci.item_code = od.use_type WHERE oh.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
AND oh.use_at = 'Y'
AND oh.use_at = 'N'
AND oh.source_type = #{sourceType}
AND (oh.order_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.user_nm ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND oh.order_no ILIKE '%' || #{orderNo} || '%'
AND c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{supplierKeyword} || '%'
AND (m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{materialKeyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{materialKeyword} || '%')
AND oh.order_dt >= CAST(#{orderDtFrom} AS date)
AND oh.order_dt <= CAST(#{orderDtTo} AS date)
AND od.delivery_dt >= CAST(#{deliveryDtFrom} AS date)
AND od.delivery_dt <= CAST(#{deliveryDtTo} AS date)
ORDER BY oh.order_dt DESC, oh.order_no DESC, od.line_no
